lead: `gaps.py --errors` reads past a `Fault::` call into the next item's doc comment, so one of its rows is a phantom.
body: A `Fault::thrown_as(...)` whose message is `format!`ed above the call carries no literal, and the tool's window finds the *following* function's `///` prose instead, listing a stem no case can contain. `conformance_coverage.rs` stops its window at a line-leading `///`, so the two counts differ by that row; a message built above the call is outside both and cannot be matched by its stem.
